content: Welcome to saber ! How may I help you?

The 7SABER Memory Foam Insoles are designed to alleviate excessive foot pressure during walking, featuring orthopedic support and cushioning that adapts to the shape of your foot. They include airholes for breathability, shock absorption, and odor reduction, making them suitable for handwashing with soap. The insoles are priced at $5.50 and are available in Black, Grey, Blue, and Red, with sizes ranging from 36/37 to 44/45.
